## Before winter break

- [ ] `quarto render` completes without an error.
- [ ] The site title, description, home introduction, and About page are mine.
- [ ] I selected `core`, `blog`, `skills`, or `full` in `_quarto.yml`.
- [ ] I kept or changed an accessible palette in `_brand.yml`.
- [ ] One existing project has a meaningful draft.
- [ ] No student number, schedule, private contact detail, or password appears.
- [ ] I kept the complete source folder, not only `_site`.

## For every complete project

- [ ] The problem and measurable success criteria are clear.
- [ ] My role and collaborators are identified honestly.
- [ ] The design includes a schematic, system model, calculation, or plan.
- [ ] Predictions are separated from simulated and measured results.
- [ ] Tables and graphs include labels, units, and useful precision.
- [ ] Code excerpts explain decisions instead of filling space.
- [ ] At least one fault, diagnostic test, and revision is explained.
- [ ] The conclusion answers the original question and names a limitation.
- [ ] Images have useful alternative text.
- [ ] Sources, licences, and adapted work are credited.

## January integrated project

- [ ] The Linux environment and relevant Python version are documented.
- [ ] The input, output, state, or data flow is explained.
- [ ] Software tests and physical circuit checks are distinguished.
- [ ] GPIO or component voltage/current limits are verified from suitable sources.
- [ ] The safe shutdown or power-off state is tested.
- [ ] Private network, account, device, and repository information is removed.

## Final two-week quality check

- [ ] No prompt text or synthetic example value remains in my claimed work.
- [ ] Home, Projects, About, and enabled optional sections all open.
- [ ] Search, category filters, and sorting work.
- [ ] Local images and relative links work after a complete render.
- [ ] The site works at phone width without sideways scrolling.
- [ ] Keyboard focus is visible and navigation can be used without a mouse.
- [ ] Text remains understandable in grayscale and without colour.
- [ ] Motion is limited and reduced-motion preferences are respected.
- [ ] Every photograph has been checked at full size for private information.
- [ ] The portfolio is ready for a three-minute tour of one strong project.

## Final command check

Run from the portfolio folder:

```sh
quarto render
python scripts/validate_portfolio.py
```

Fix source files and render again. Do not repair generated HTML inside `_site`.
